subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: After `richMessages` made rich-versus-standard delivery configurable, should Telegram also let operators force plain text or another parse mode, and should that evolve the existing selector rather than add a parallel setting?
rationale: The remaining gap defines new public configuration, defaults, inheritance, escaping, and cross-funnel behavior that cannot be selected mechanically from the report.

options.title: Add safe plain mode
options.body: Evolve the existing account-aware rendering policy to support standard text, plain text, and rich messages while retaining standard text as the default.

options.title: Keep automatic fallback
options.body: Leave plain text as parse-error recovery and fix individual formatter defects without adding another setting.

options.title: Add broad parse modes
options.body: Support MarkdownV2 or raw HTML only after approving explicit escaping, trust, and compatibility semantics.

recommendation.title: Add safe plain mode
recommendation.body: Evolve the existing account-aware rendering policy to support standard text, plain text, and rich messages while retaining standard text as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current account-aware rendering selector and cross-funnel standard/rich behavior that the decision would evolve.
